spade-08.exo: Interference, unexpected obstacles, impediments that hold back action. It points to situations blocked by details, by outside people, or by an excess of options and scruples.
spade-08.psy: The distracted, overloaded mind, lost in alternatives and doubts until it can no longer move. Often the cage is made of your own thoughts.
spade-08.ini: Air in Hod, intellectual Splendour, with Jupiter in Gemini, his sign of detriment, in the first decan: Jupiterian benevolence fragments into Mercurial multiplicity. Interference is the will scattering in a thousand directions for lack of a centre.
spade-08.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals confusion, paralysis, pettiness, an inability to see the whole.
spade-08.up: Identify the real interference, separating it from the imagined ones, and concentrate your forces on the essential.
spade-08.rev: Obstacles that begin to dissolve; or blocks that worsen because you lack the courage to choose.
spade-08.love: Outside interference, doubts, misunderstandings; too many words and too little clarity.
spade-08.work: Bureaucracy, setbacks, small errors that slow things down; simplifying helps.
spade-08.spirit: Freeing the mind of the superfluous to find a single centre again.
spade-08.crowley: Crowley crosses two long vertical swords with six short swords of different shapes and cultures: a mind disturbed by too many heterogeneous interferences.

spade-09.exo: Anguish, worries, sleepless nights, cruelty suffered or inflicted. It points to mental suffering, guilt, fears that magnify problems.
spade-09.psy: The mind turning against itself: obsessive thoughts, merciless self-criticism, wounds that reopen from being thought over again and again.
spade-09.ini: Air in Yesod, the Foundation, with Mars in Gemini in the second decan: Martial violence hits a fragmented mind. Cruelty is the intellect descended into the instinctual regions, where reason, deprived of light, becomes fanaticism and torment.
spade-09.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals deliberate cruelty, fanaticism, vengeance, despair.
spade-09.up: Fears are ruling the mind: recognise how much is real and how much is produced by anxiety, and ask for help if needed.
spade-09.rev: The anguish begins to dissolve; or it is smothered and turns into resentment or cruelty toward others.
spade-09.love: Jealousy, guilt, cutting words; a need for dialogue and mutual kindness.
spade-09.work: Stress, harsh conflicts, a hostile atmosphere; it matters not to take work to bed.
spade-09.spirit: Crossing the night of the mind with the discipline of awareness.
spade-09.crowley: In the Thoth deck nine swords of differing lengths, jagged and rusted, drip blood and poison downward: the intellect degraded into cruel instinct.

spade-10.exo: Ruin, a painful end, the collapse of a plan or a situation. It points to a clean conclusion which, once the bottom has been touched, leaves room only for rebuilding.
spade-10.psy: The mind which, pushing reasoning to the extreme, destroys what it had built; the end of illusions and defence strategies.
spade-10.ini: Air in Malkuth, with the Sun in Gemini in the third decan: sunlight fragmented by the dual mind. Ruin is the intellect cut off from its source, reason which, left to itself, breaks down every harmony into chaos.
spade-10.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals disaster, despair, blind destruction, relentlessness.
spade-10.up: Something has ended for good: accept it, because only after the end can rebuilding begin.
spade-10.rev: The worst is over and the climb begins; or resistance to recognising an ending that has already happened.
spade-10.love: A breakup, the end of a bond; a need to close in order to heal.
spade-10.work: Failure, the closing of a project, loss; time to start again on new foundations.
spade-10.spirit: The ruin of the mental ego as a prelude to a higher understanding.
spade-10.crowley: Crowley arranges ten swords according to the sephiroth of the Tree: the hilts occupy the places of the sephiroth, and the sword of Tiphareth, the heart, is broken by the others, beneath a red sky.

spade-cavaliere.exo: An intelligent, quick, combative and decisive person, or a lightning action that changes the cards on the table. It points to sudden changes, attacks, ideas that burst in with force.
spade-cavaliere.psy: The mental side that acts without hesitation: lucidity, intellectual courage and readiness, but also impulsiveness, intolerance and little attention to emotional consequences.
spade-cavaliere.ini: Fire of Air, the Yod of Vau, referred to Chokmah: the impetuous wind, the storm sweeping the sky. He rules from 21° Taurus to 20° Gemini, where Taurean tenacity becomes the weapon of Mercurial speed.
spade-cavaliere.sha: Ill-dignified, he is overbearing, brutal, unable to decide or to listen.
spade-cavaliere.up: Act with decision and speed: your intelligence can make the difference.
spade-cavaliere.rev: Attacks that miss, hasty decisions, verbal aggression.
spade-cavaliere.love: A decisive but restless partner; a risk of quarrels and misunderstandings.
spade-cavaliere.work: Rapid actions, bold strategies, the ability to meet challenges.
spade-cavaliere.spirit: The sword of the mind in the service of the Will, not of pride.
spade-cavaliere.crowley: The Knight of Swords in the Thoth deck gallops on his steed with drawn sword and a dagger, amid swallows in a dive: the very idea of attack, swift and direct.

spade-regina.exo: A sharp, independent and lucid person, or the ability to see beyond appearances. It points to unpleasant but liberating truths, impartial judgements, decisions that cut away the superfluous.
spade-regina.psy: The mind that unmasks illusions and defences: sincerity, autonomy, the ability to observe without becoming involved; it can stiffen into coldness.
spade-regina.ini: Water of Air, the He of Vau, referred to Binah: the clouds, air made visible. She rules from 21° Virgo to 20° Libra, joining the analytical precision of Virgo to the sense of justice of Libra.
spade-regina.sha: Ill-dignified, she is cruel, sarcastic, unreliable, able to wound with words.
spade-regina.up: Look at the situation without illusions: the truth sets you free.
spade-regina.rev: Judgement that is too harsh, or a fear of the truth; sarcasm, coldness, isolation.
spade-regina.love: An independent, frank partner; a relationship that demands absolute sincerity.
spade-regina.work: Analysis, judgement, objective management, the ability to expose problems.
spade-regina.crowley: The Queen of the Thoth deck, seated among the clouds, holds the sword and the severed head of a bearded man, a symbol of illusions cut away by the mind; on her head she wears the head of a child.

spade-principe.exo: A brilliant person full of ideas, but changeable and little inclined to conclude; or a project that is still all in the mind. It points to complex reasoning, theories, plans that keep changing.
spade-principe.psy: The pure mind that builds and demolishes its own architectures: a lively intelligence that risks spinning idly, detached from feeling and the body.
spade-principe.ini: Air of Air, the Vau of Vau, referred to Tiphareth: the intellect in its own element, thought generating thought. He rules from 21° Capricorn to 20° Aquarius, where Saturnine ambition meets Aquarian vision, fertile in ideas but without emotional anchoring.
spade-principe.sha: Ill-dignified, he is indecisive, cynical, calculating, able to destroy for the pleasure of analysing.
spade-principe.up: Your ideas are valid: choose one, give it a direction and put it to the test of facts.
spade-principe.rev: Confused and contradictory thoughts, projects multiplying without being realised, cold detachment.
spade-principe.love: A stimulating but distant partner; plenty of dialogue, little emotional intimacy.
spade-principe.work: Innovative projects, strategic thinking, theoretical research; someone is needed to make it concrete.
spade-principe.spirit: Using the mind as a tool of the Will, not as its master.
spade-principe.crowley: The Prince of Swords in the Thoth deck drives a chariot drawn by small winged beings pulling in different directions; with the sword he creates and with the scythe he destroys: the mind that finds no rest.

spade-principessa.astro: Celestial quadrant of Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces; throne of the Ace
spade-principessa.exo: A young, alert and determined person, able to defend herself and to step in promptly. It points to conflicts to be handled with common sense, uncomfortable truths to face, the need to protect something.
spade-principessa.psy: The intellect descending into concrete life: pragmatism, lucidity in crises, the ability to say no. It can stiffen into suspicion or a spirit of revenge.
spade-principessa.ini: Earth of Air, the final He of Vau, referred to Malkuth: the wind that subsides and condenses the clouds into concrete form. Throne of the Ace of Swords, she rules the celestial quadrant of Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces, guardian of the vengeance of the gods that restores order.
spade-principessa.sha: Ill-dignified, she is cunning, petty, frivolous, vindictive, ready to strike out of fear.
spade-principessa.up: Act with firmness and prudence: protect what matters and cut away what is no longer needed.
spade-principessa.rev: Excessive defences, suspicion, petty retaliation; or an inability to set necessary boundaries.
spade-principessa.love: A relationship that asks for clarity and healthy boundaries; frank but constructive discussions.
spade-principessa.work: Solving practical problems, crisis management, quality control and checks.
spade-principessa.spirit: Wisdom that becomes concrete, vigilant action.
spade-principessa.crowley: The Princess of Swords is an Athena-like figure, armed and helmeted, who plunges her sword before a bare altar beneath a stormy sky: the incarnated mind defending order.
